# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 68 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 68

**1** Jesus said: "You are blessed when people hate you and hunt you down — for there will be no place found where you have been persecuted."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Hunt you down" — intensifies the persecution as active pursuit
- "For there will be no place found" — the "for" establishes the enigmatic clause as the reason for the blessedness
- The saying suggests the persecuted one transcends any location of suffering; suffering leaves no permanent address
